test_title: PYST 24: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, W, D, J, S, H, G and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing south. G sits second to the left of S. G is the immediate neighbour of D and H. Y sits third to the right of D. Only two people sit to the right of W.

Who sits at the extreme right end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, W, D, J, S, H, G and Y are sitting in a straight line, facing south

1) G sits second to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8653ac2de50d7f8ea5a3b51b7d22c1fc1907ce12c3dbd1500d5113dc76ef927e.png] 

2) G is the immediate neighbour of D and H.
